Job Title: Senior GenAI Engineer Python | RAG | LLM

Location: Mumbai
Experience: 6–10 Years

Job Overview:
We are looking for an experienced AI/GenAI Engineer to build scalable AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and deploy LLM-based applications
Design RAG pipelines using vector databases
Build AI agents using LangChain / AutoGen
Integrate APIs and backend services

Must Have Skills:

Strong Python development
Hands-on with LLMs + RAG
Experience with LangChain / similar frameworks
Vector DB knowledge

Note:
Only candidates with real project experience in LLM/RAG will be considered
Serving Notice Period, Candidates who can join before 10th July,2026
